sources.description: concat_ws(' ', CASE WHEN "IsDirectory" = 'True' THEN '[folder]' END, 'size=' || "FileSize", CASE WHEN "InUse" = 'False' THEN '[free/deleted record]' END, CASE WHEN "SI<FN" = 'True' THEN '[SI<FN: possible timestomping]' END, CASE WHEN "uSecZeros" = 'True' THEN '[zero µs]' END, CASE WHEN "ZoneIdContents" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Zone.Identifier: ' || replace(replace("ZoneIdContents", chr(13), ''), chr(10), ' ') END)
sources.note: MFTECmd only provides the $FN dates when they differ from the $SI ones.

sources.note: Default.rdp: last mstsc connection of the user (file modification ≈ last connection). Other .rdp files: received or downloaded (phishing with .rdp files). Full settings in the settings column; passwords excluded.

setupact.log / setuperr.log: local time of the machine, converted with the CURRENT time zone (ActiveTimeBias); during the first setup phases the time zone is not configured yet: possible offset of a few hours.
Saved tabs: ts timestamp (modification) in the timeline; never-saved tabs: no timestamp, raw table only (content, deleted content).
COM hijacking: per-user CLSID registrations (HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID) take precedence over HKLM; an InprocServer32 / LocalServer32 outside System32, SysWOW64 or Program Files must be explained.
Any non-empty AppInit_DLLs value (with LoadAppInit_DLLs = 1) is loaded into every process linked to user32.dll: persistence / injection to be explained.
Thumbnails of images / documents viewed in Explorer, including files deleted since; the identifier links to the Windows Search index (System_ThumbnailCacheId).
Archives opened / created with 7-Zip (ArcHistory, PathHistory, CopyHistory): staging of data before exfiltration.
Dissect plugin without a dedicated entry: dates taken from the recorddescriptors.
Path, size and SHA-256 of the memory image, computed before the analysis.
Name, size and SHA-256 of every capture, computed before the analysis.

detection.level: CASE CAST("alert_severity" AS VARCHAR) WHEN '1' THEN 'high' WHEN '2' THEN 'medium' WHEN '3' THEN 'low' ELSE 'informational' END

sources.note: Severity 1 = high, 2 = medium, 3 = low (ET Open). The HTTP / DNS / TLS context of the alert is in raw.suricata_alert.
SMB, RDP, SSH, SMTP, FTP, DHCP, Kerberos, DCERPC, QUIC...: one table per event type.
